name: N-acetyltryptamine
summary: N-Acetyltryptamine (NAcT) is an organic compound with the molecular formula C12H14N2O. It is a partial agonist for the melatonin receptors. N-Acetyltryptamine is produced by Streptomyces djakartensis and other Streptomyces and Fusarium species.

pharmacology.text: It is a partial agonist for the melatonin receptors.
